title: Misafir giris (kayitsiz)
purpose: Implements FR-E1-09: Guest session without profile creation. Discover + detail accessible; content start/read redirects to registration. Guest browsing data transfers to account post-registration.

loading.description: Skeleton capability/limitation cards while checking guest eligibility.

ready.description: Capabilities card (explore, browse, view catalog), limitations card (no start/read/comment/save), primary Continue as Guest CTA, and secondary Register button.

empty.description: Message explaining guest mode is unavailable, with link to register instead.

error.description: Banner explaining guest initialisation failed with retry action.

offline.description: Guest mode works offline for cached content browsing. Offline banner shown with reduced feature set.
